activities.title: What Are They Building? Working Systems, Not Ideas

lessons.content:
## Real Practitioners, Real Systems

These aren't thought leaders theorizing. These are finance professionals who have built and deployed working AI systems:

### The Builders

| Who | What They Built | Impact |
|-----|----------------|--------|
| **Mohamed Muse Said** | 7-step month-end close automation | Structured close process with AI at every step |
| **Brock Beyer** | Allocation workflows with built-in balance controls | 25 Claude skills for accountants, copy-paste ready |
| **Wouter Born** | P&L to board deck pipeline | Minutes instead of hours for board-ready materials |
| **Devon Coombs** | "Treat AI Like Staff" delegation framework | A mental model that works for any task |
| **Alyona Mysko** | Live FP&A data via MCP connections | Real-time financial data flowing into AI agents |
| **Alex Altman** | 6-agent finance stack | An entire finance function run by agents + 1 human + 1 accountant |
| **Kyle Geers** | Multi-agent AP inbox | Automated accounts payable processing |

### What Makes Them Different

They're not talking about what AI *could* do. They're sharing what it *is* doing — in their actual workflows, with their actual data. And they're sharing the playbooks openly.

> **The AI-in-finance community is small, generous, and moving fast.** The people winning are the ones who start building and sharing.

lessons.content:
## The Playbook for Learning from Practitioners

### Step 1: Follow 16+ Practitioners on LinkedIn

These are the voices posting real workflows, not motivational AI content:

- [Alyona Mysko](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alyona-mysko/) — FP&A + MCP
- [Wouter Born](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wouterborn/) — Financial modeling + board decks
- [Brock Beyer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brockbeyer/) — Claude skills for accounting
- [Devon Coombs](https://www.linkedin.com/in/devoncoombs/) — AI delegation frameworks
- [Mohamed Muse Said](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohamedmusesaid/) — Month-end close automation
- [Nathan Saperia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathansaperia/) — AI implementation strategy
- [Jason Staats](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jstaats/) — Accounting + AI use cases
- [Kyle Geers](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kylegeers/) — Multi-agent AP systems
- [Em Daigle](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emdaigle/) — Finance process transformation
- [Sowmya Ranganathan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sowmyaranganathan/) — Finance AI adoption
- [Christian Martinez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/christianmartinezthefinancialfox/) — The Financial Fox
- [Nathan Mapp, CPA](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathan-mapp-cpa/) — AI for CPAs

### Step 2: Read Their Guides on Finney

Every practitioner has structured guides on [finney.finance](https://finney.finance) — step-by-step walkthroughs you can follow with your own data.

### Step 3: Pick One Workflow That Matches Your Pain Point

Don't try to learn everything. Find the one person solving the problem you have today. Steal their approach — they're sharing it for exactly this reason.

> **The community is small enough that you can know most of the key voices.** Join now or catch up later.

lessons.content:
## Every Practitioner Profile Is a Reusable Playbook

You don't need to figure this out alone. These playbooks are ready to implement:

### Brock Beyer's 25 Claude Skills for Accountants
Copy-paste ready skills covering:
- Journal entry drafting and review
- Allocation calculations with balance controls
- Variance analysis and commentary
- Reconciliation workflows
- Financial statement preparation

→ [See the full list on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/brockbeyer_25-claude-skills-for-accountants-ugcPost-7459999338610675712-joe3/)

### Mohamed's Month-End Close Steps
A structured 7-step process you can implement this month:
1. Draft adjusting journal entries
2. Review and validate entries
3. Run reconciliations
4. Generate variance commentary
5. Prepare financial statements
6. Build the board deck
7. Archive and document

→ [Month-End Close Guide on Finney](https://finney.finance/program/month-end-close-draft-adjusting-journal-entries)

### Devon's "Treat AI Like Staff" Framework
A delegation model that works on any task:
- Define the role (what would you tell a new hire?)
- Set the context (what do they need to know?)
- Give them access (what tools do they need?)
- Review their work (trust but verify)

→ [Full Guide on Finney](https://finney.finance/program/treat-ai-like-staff-a-practical-guide-to-using-agentic-ai-tools)

### Wouter's P&L to Board Deck Pipeline
Take raw financial data and produce a board-ready capital allocation deck in minutes, not hours.

→ [Full Guide on Finney](https://finney.finance/program/how-to-turn-a-p-l-into-a-board-ready-capital-allocation-deck-with-claude)

> **These are not theoretical frameworks. They are working systems you can copy today.**

lessons.content:
## Your Action Plan for This Week

### Today (5 minutes)
1. Open LinkedIn
2. Follow at least 5 practitioners from the list
3. Turn on notifications for their posts

### This Week (30 minutes)
1. Read one guide on [finney.finance](https://finney.finance)
2. Pick the one closest to a problem you're dealing with right now
3. Try the workflow with your own data

### This Month (2 hours)
1. Implement one full workflow from a practitioner's playbook
2. Track your time savings (before vs. after)
3. Share what you learned — post on LinkedIn or contribute to the Finney Wiki

### Ongoing
1. Join the [AI in Finance Slack Community](https://join.slack.com/share/enQtMTEyMDA0MDE3OTQ0NjgtNWYwY2YwYmQ3Njg2NGVlYzY4NmYyZWYxMTg2MTYwN2VkNjM0OWMxYTliNTFkNjc1ZTBiNTY3OGRjN2MxMThjOQ)
2. Contribute your own use cases to the wiki
3. Help someone else get started

---

### Why This Matters

The AI-in-finance community is in its earliest days. The people who join now — who build, share, and contribute — will be the ones everyone else learns from in 2 years.

> **The community is small enough that you can know most of the key voices. Join now or catch up later.**

📎 **References:**
- [Finney Wiki](https://finney.finance/wiki)
- [Accounting Wiki](https://finney.finance/wiki/function/accounting/wiki)
- [Tax Wiki](https://finney.finance/wiki/function/tax/wiki)
